cues.en: So let's say we multiply this by two, we would receive two, four and six.

One is that given the same input, it will always return the same output.

cues.en: That is, every time we give one, two and three to this list, we give it to a function that we create.

cues.zh: 就算以相同輸入執行幾百萬次，輸出也相同。

cues.en: And the second point is this idea of a function should not produce any side effects.
cues.zh: 第二，函式不應產生副作用。

cues.en: What are side effects?
Side effects are things that a function does that affects the outside world.
cues.zh: 就是函式影響外部世界的行為。

cues.en: For example, if I was to print something inside of this function, it affects the outside world, right?
cues.zh: 例如，在函式裡 print，會影響外部世界，對吧？

cues.en: Because I'm printing something onto a screen.
cues.zh: 因為把內容印到螢幕上。

cues.en: The screen is the outside world.
Or for example, if this function was touching a variable that lived outside of a different scope, that's a side effect.
cues.zh: 或者，函式修改其他作用域裡的變數，也是一種副作用。

cues.en: Now, it's hard to really understand why this is such a powerful concept without having a bit of experience in the workplace.

cues.zh: 但我想告訴你，有純函式時，

cues.zh: 程式比較少錯誤，也比較好測試。

cues.en: It's easier to understand your code and overall.

cues.en: So this idea of pure functions is really important.

cues.zh: 但希望你記住，純函式比較像準則，不是絕對規定。

cues.en: It is impossible to have pure functions everywhere, because if a function doesn't affect the outside world at all, well, we wouldn't have any programs.
cues.zh: 不可能到處都是純函式，因為完全不影響外界，就沒有實際可用的程式。
